title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired tagine made with lamb, a blend of spices, and dried fruits. This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the onion to the pot.
Cook the onion until it's softened and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried fruits and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Return the lamb to the pot and add enough water to cover it.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Skim off any excess fat from the surface of the sauce.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs and crusty bread on the side.
